paragraphs.text: A Cooking for today
paragraphs.translation: 今日烹饪

paragraphs.text: These are classes for those of you who can already make basic meals by keeping strictly to a simple recipe, but who would now like to use your imagination as well. We'll learn how to make great family meals, discovering how to develop basic recipes into personal creations, with a few tricks and tips to help you become more confident.
paragraphs.translation:
我们将学习如何制作美味的家庭餐，探索如何将基本食谱发展为个人创意，并提供一些技巧和小窍门，帮助你变得更加自信。
这些课程适合那些已经能够严格按照简单食谱制作基本餐食，但现在还想运用自己的想象力的人。
我们将学习如何制作美味家庭餐，探索如何将基本食谱发展为个人创意，并利用一些小技巧和贴士帮助你变得更加自信。

paragraphs.text: B Entertaining the easy way
paragraphs.translation: B 轻松待客之道

paragraphs.text: This course has plenty of ideas and tips for special occasions that you can enjoy preparing, love eating and be proud to provide. The recipes are adaptable to your needs and lifestyle, building on your current skills and aimed at developing your own cooking style.
paragraphs.translation:
这些食谱可根据你的需求和生活方式进行调整，基于你现有的技能，并旨在培养你自己的烹饪风格。
本课程提供大量针对特殊场合的创意与建议，这些场合中你能享受准备过程、喜爱品尝食物并自豪地呈现给他人。
这些食谱可根据你的需求和生活方式进行调整，以你现有技能为基础，旨在培养你自己的烹饪风格。

paragraphs.text: C Cooking for the family
paragraphs.translation: C 为家人烹饪

paragraphs.text: Keen to make better food for your kids? This course is for parents who want to learn how to make fun food with the aim of showing their kids how to cook later at home. We'll learn plenty of tasty tips for snacks and picnics, family favourites, and dishes with fresh fruit and vegetables so that you and your family can get really fit and well and enjoy your food.
paragraphs.translation:
本课程面向那些希望学习如何制作有趣食物的家长，以便日后在家中教孩子烹饪。
我们将学习大量关于零食、野餐、家庭最爱菜肴以及新鲜水果蔬菜菜品的实用小贴士，这样你和家人就能保持健康、享受美食。
渴望为孩子制作更美味的食物吗？
本课程面向那些希望学习制作趣味食物、并旨在日后在家教孩子烹饪的家长。
我们将学习大量关于零食、野餐、家庭最爱菜肴以及新鲜水果蔬菜菜品的实用技巧，以便您和家人能够保持健康并享受美食。

paragraphs.text: D Jewellery making
paragraphs.translation: D 珠宝制作

paragraphs.text: This course aims to enable students to create silver jewellery. Your first project will be to make a silver ring and then you will have an opportunity to create another piece of your own design. This is an introductory course. Base metals are supplied free. Please wear suitable workshop clothing and bring a notebook and pen.
paragraphs.translation:
你的第一个项目将是制作一枚银戒指，之后你将有机会创作另一件自己设计的作品。
这是一个入门课程。
基础金属材料免费提供。
请穿着合适的工坊服装，并携带笔记本和笔。
本课程旨在让学生能够制作银饰。
你的第一个项目将是制作一枚银戒指，然后你将有机会创作另一件自己设计的作品。
这是一门入门课程。
基本金属材料免费提供。

paragraphs.text: E Photography
paragraphs.translation: E 摄影

paragraphs.text: This course will allow you to take full advantage of your digital camera. Covering portrait, landscape and still-life photography, the classes will include effective use of lenses and lighting. To really benefit from the course, learners should have time to read ahead between sessions.
paragraphs.translation:
课程涵盖人像、风景和静物摄影，内容包括有效使用镜头和照明。
为真正从课程中受益，学习者应有时间在课间提前阅读相关材料。
本课程将让你充分利用你的数码相机。
涵盖人像、风景和静物摄影，课程将包括有效使用镜头和照明。
为了真正从课程中受益，学习者应在课程间歇有时间预先阅读。

paragraphs.text: F Creative writing
paragraphs.translation: F 创意写作

paragraphs.text: Come and learn how to have fun with stories and other kinds of creative writing. We will try out some new ideas and techniques for improving style and waking up the imagination. Writers who have not taken the foundation class will also be able to join, provided they already have some experience of the subject.
paragraphs.translation:
我们将尝试一些新的想法和技巧，以提升写作风格并激发想象力。
未参加过基础课程的写作者也可以加入，前提是他们已经具备该领域的一些经验。
快来学习如何享受故事及其他创意写作的乐趣吧。
我们将尝试一些新思路和技巧，以改进写作风格并激发想象力。
未参加过基础课程的作者也可以加入，前提是他们已经具备一些相关经验。

paragraphs.text: The Bike Foundry
paragraphs.translation: 自行车工坊

paragraphs.text: The Bike Foundry aims to promote cycling, and to make an environmentally-friendly means of transport and leisure available to as many people as we can.
paragraphs.translation:
自行车工坊
自行车铸造厂旨在推广骑行，并尽可能让更多人享受到一种环保的交通和休闲方式。

paragraphs.text: Our Bikes
paragraphs.translation: 我们的自行车

paragraphs.text: All our bikes are hand-restored by our team and come with a three months' guarantee. We stock bikes to suit different needs, at affordable prices. We gratefully accept donations of unwanted bikes.
paragraphs.translation:
我们备有满足不同需求的自行车，价格实惠。
我们欣然接受不需要的自行车的捐赠。
我们的自行车
我们所有的自行车都由团队手工修复，并附带三个月保修期。
我们库存各类自行车以满足不同需求，价格实惠。
我们诚挚接受不需要的自行车的捐赠。

paragraphs.text: Training
paragraphs.translation: 培训

paragraphs.text: We offer maintenance and cycle training to schools and small groups on their own premises. Additionally we provide training to individuals and groups in our workshops.
paragraphs.translation:
此外，我们还在工坊内为个人和团体提供培训。
培训
我们为学校和小团体在其场所内提供维修和自行车培训。
此外，我们还在自己的工作坊为个人和团体提供培训。

paragraphs.text: Maintenance Training
paragraphs.translation:
培训
维护培训

paragraphs.text: Bike Basics
paragraphs.translation: 自行车基础

paragraphs.text: This is a three-hour course which will teach you everything you need to know to keep on top of simple maintenance issues like looking after brakes and gears and how to repair a puncture. By the end of the course you'll know how to take good care of your bike.
paragraphs.translation:
课程结束时，你将知道如何妥善保养你的自行车。
这是一门时长三小时的课程，将教你掌握处理简单维护问题所需的一切知识，例如保养刹车和齿轮，以及如何修补轮胎破洞。
课程结束时，你将学会如何妥善照顾自己的自行车。

paragraphs.text: Home Mechanics
paragraphs.translation: 家庭机械维修

paragraphs.text: This twelve-hour course consists of teaching you how to use specialist tools and how to fit compatible replacement parts. It's aimed at those who have completed Bike Basics or have some prior knowledge.
paragraphs.translation:
它面向已完成自行车基础课程或具备一些先验知识的学员。
自行车基础
这个为期十二小时的课程包括教你如何使用专业工具以及如何安装兼容的替换零件。
该课程面向那些已经完成“自行车基础”课程或具有一定先备知识的人。

paragraphs.text: Courses are run regularly for groups of up to four trainees. We use professional mechanics' tools and employ experienced staff. Most importantly, we have tea- and coffee-making facilities and a fridge where participants can keep their sandwiches, etc. Unfortunately our training room is up a flight of stairs.
paragraphs.translation:
我们使用专业机械工具，并雇佣经验丰富的员工。
最重要的是，我们提供茶和咖啡制作设施，以及一个冰箱供参与者存放三明治等物品。
遗憾的是，我们的培训室位于一段楼梯之上。
培训
课程定期为最多四名学员的小组开设。
我们使用专业机械工具，并聘请经验丰富的员工。
最重要的是，我们有茶水和咖啡制作设施以及一个冰箱，参与者可以存放他们的三明治等物品。
不幸的是，我们的培训室在一段楼梯之上。

paragraphs.text: For £10 a year you can join our Tool Club. Membership gives you access to our workshop for one evening a week. If you want to repair your bike and know how to fix it, but lack specialist tools, then join our club. There's a range of reference manuals available and a mechanic to offer advice.
paragraphs.translation:
会员资格让你每周有一个晚上可以使用我们的工坊。
如果你想修理自行车且知道如何修复，但缺乏专业工具，那么加入我们的俱乐部吧。
这里有一系列参考手册可用，还有一位机械师提供建议。
每年只需支付10英镑，你就可以加入我们的工具俱乐部。
会员资格让你每周有一个晚上可以使用我们的工作坊。
如果你想修理自行车并且知道如何修理，但缺少专业工具，那么请加入我们的俱乐部。
那里提供一系列参考手册，还有一名机械师可以提供建议。

paragraphs.text: Cycling Training
paragraphs.translation:
培训
骑行训练

paragraphs.text: Our qualified instructors can teach you how to ride your bike, whether you have had prior experience or not. If you're already riding and would like to build your confidence, we can teach you safe techniques to negotiate traffic.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你已经在骑行并希望增强自信，我们可以教你应对交通的安全技巧。
我们合格的教练可以教你如何骑自行车，无论你是否有过先前经验。
如果你已经在骑车并希望建立自信，我们可以教你安全应对交通的技巧。

paragraphs.text: Booking Information
paragraphs.translation: 预订信息

paragraphs.text: To book a place, email training@bikefoundry.org
paragraphs.translation:
培训
要预订名额，请发送电子邮件至training@bikefoundry.org。

paragraphs.text: We ask for a 50% deposit to confirm your place, refundable up to seven days before the course.
paragraphs.translation: 我们要求支付50%的定金以确认您的名额，该定金在课程开始前七天之内可退。

sentence_translations.sentence: A Cooking for today
sentence_translations.translation: 今日烹饪

sentence_translations.sentence: 1. These are classes for those of you who can already make basic meals by keeping strictly to a simple recipe, but who would now like to use your imagination as well.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些课程面向那些已经能够严格遵循简单食谱制作基本餐点，但现在也希望发挥想象力的学员。

sentence_translations.sentence: We'll learn how to make great family meals, discovering how to develop basic recipes into personal creations, with a few tricks and tips to help you become more confident.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将学习如何制作美味的家庭餐，探索如何将基本食谱发展为个人创意，并提供一些技巧和小窍门，帮助你变得更加自信。

sentence_translations.sentence: 2. B Entertaining the easy way
sentence_translations.translation: 轻松待客之道

sentence_translations.sentence: 3. This course has plenty of ideas and tips for special occasions that you can enjoy preparing, love eating and be proud to provide.
sentence_translations.translation: 本课程提供了大量适用于特殊场合的创意和技巧，让你能够享受准备过程、热爱品尝并为呈上美食感到自豪。

sentence_translations.sentence: The recipes are adaptable to your needs and lifestyle, building on your current skills and aimed at developing your own cooking style.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些食谱可根据你的需求和生活方式进行调整，基于你现有的技能，并旨在培养你自己的烹饪风格。

sentence_translations.sentence: 4. C Cooking for the family
sentence_translations.translation: 家庭烹饪

sentence_translations.sentence: 5. Keen to make better food for your kids?
sentence_translations.translation: 是否渴望为你的孩子制作更美味的食物？

sentence_translations.sentence: This course is for parents who want to learn how to make fun food with the aim of showing their kids how to cook later at home.
sentence_translations.translation: 本课程面向那些希望学习如何制作有趣食物的家长，以便日后在家中教孩子烹饪。

sentence_translations.sentence: We'll learn plenty of tasty tips for snacks and picnics, family favourites, and dishes with fresh fruit and vegetables so that you and your family can get really fit and well and enjoy your food.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将学习大量关于零食、野餐、家庭最爱菜肴以及新鲜水果蔬菜菜品的实用小贴士，这样你和家人就能保持健康、享受美食。

sentence_translations.sentence: 6. D Jewellery making
sentence_translations.translation: 珠宝制作

sentence_translations.sentence: 7. This course aims to enable students to create silver jewellery.
sentence_translations.translation: 本课程旨在让学生能够制作银质珠宝。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your first project will be to make a silver ring and then you will have an opportunity to create another piece of your own design.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的第一个项目将是制作一枚银戒指，之后你将有机会创作另一件自己设计的作品。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is an introductory course.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一个入门课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: Base metals are supplied free.
sentence_translations.translation: 基础金属材料免费提供。

sentence_translations.sentence: Please wear suitable workshop clothing and bring a notebook and pen.
sentence_translations.translation: 请穿着合适的工坊服装，并携带笔记本和笔。

sentence_translations.sentence: 8. E Photography
sentence_translations.translation: 摄影

sentence_translations.sentence: 9. This course will allow you to take full advantage of your digital camera.
sentence_translations.translation: 本课程将让你充分利用你的数码相机。

sentence_translations.sentence: Covering portrait, landscape and still-life photography, the classes will include effective use of lenses and lighting.
sentence_translations.translation: 课程涵盖人像、风景和静物摄影，内容包括有效使用镜头和照明。

sentence_translations.sentence: To really benefit from the course, learners should have time to read ahead between sessions.
sentence_translations.translation: 为真正从课程中受益，学习者应有时间在课间提前阅读相关材料。

sentence_translations.sentence: 10. F Creative writing
sentence_translations.translation: 创意写作

sentence_translations.sentence: 11. Come and learn how to have fun with stories and other kinds of creative writing.
sentence_translations.translation: 来学习如何享受故事及其他创意写作的乐趣。

sentence_translations.sentence: We will try out some new ideas and techniques for improving style and waking up the imagination.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将尝试一些新的想法和技巧，以提升写作风格并激发想象力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Writers who have not taken the foundation class will also be able to join, provided they already have some experience of the subject.
sentence_translations.translation: 未参加过基础课程的写作者也可以加入，前提是他们已经具备该领域的一些经验。

sentence_translations.sentence: 12. The Bike Foundry
sentence_translations.translation: 自行车工坊

sentence_translations.sentence: 13. The Bike Foundry aims to promote cycling, and to make an environmentally-friendly means of transport and leisure available to as many people as we can.
sentence_translations.translation: 自行车工坊旨在推广骑行，并尽可能让更多人获得这种环保的交通和休闲方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: 14. Our Bikes
sentence_translations.translation: 我们的自行车

sentence_translations.sentence: 15. All our bikes are hand-restored by our team and come with a three months' guarantee.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们所有的自行车均由团队手工翻新，并提供三个月保修。

sentence_translations.sentence: We stock bikes to suit different needs, at affordable prices.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们备有满足不同需求的自行车，价格实惠。

sentence_translations.sentence: We gratefully accept donations of unwanted bikes.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们欣然接受不需要的自行车的捐赠。

sentence_translations.sentence: 16. Training
sentence_translations.translation: 培训

sentence_translations.sentence: 17. We offer maintenance and cycle training to schools and small groups on their own premises.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们在学校和小团体的场所提供维修和骑行培训。

sentence_translations.sentence: Additionally we provide training to individuals and groups in our workshops.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，我们还在工坊内为个人和团体提供培训。

sentence_translations.sentence: 18. Maintenance Training
sentence_translations.translation: 维修培训

sentence_translations.sentence: 19. Bike Basics
sentence_translations.translation: 自行车基础

sentence_translations.sentence: 20. This is a three-hour course which will teach you everything you need to know to keep on top of simple maintenance issues like looking after brakes and gears and how to repair a puncture.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一个三小时的课程，将教你掌握处理简单维修问题所需的一切知识，例如保养刹车和齿轮以及如何修补轮胎。

sentence_translations.sentence: By the end of the course you'll know how to take good care of your bike.
sentence_translations.translation: 课程结束时，你将知道如何妥善保养你的自行车。

sentence_translations.sentence: 21. Home Mechanics
sentence_translations.translation: 家庭机械维修

sentence_translations.sentence: 22. This twelve-hour course consists of teaching you how to use specialist tools and how to fit compatible replacement parts.
sentence_translations.translation: 这个十二小时的课程包括教你如何使用专业工具以及如何安装兼容的替换零件。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's aimed at those who have completed Bike Basics or have some prior knowledge.
sentence_translations.translation: 它面向已完成自行车基础课程或具备一些先验知识的学员。

sentence_translations.sentence: 23. Courses are run regularly for groups of up to four trainees.
sentence_translations.translation: 课程定期举办，每组最多四名学员。

sentence_translations.sentence: We use professional mechanics' tools and employ experienced staff.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们使用专业机械工具，并雇佣经验丰富的员工。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most importantly, we have tea- and coffee-making facilities and a fridge where participants can keep their sandwiches, etc.
sentence_translations.translation: 最重要的是，我们提供茶和咖啡制作设施，以及一个冰箱供参与者存放三明治等物品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Unfortunately our training room is up a flight of stairs.
sentence_translations.translation: 遗憾的是，我们的培训室位于一段楼梯之上。

sentence_translations.sentence: 24. For £10 a year you can join our Tool Club.
sentence_translations.translation: 每年支付10英镑，你就可以加入我们的工具俱乐部。

sentence_translations.sentence: Membership gives you access to our workshop for one evening a week.
sentence_translations.translation: 会员资格让你每周有一个晚上可以使用我们的工坊。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you want to repair your bike and know how to fix it, but lack specialist tools, then join our club.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你想修理自行车且知道如何修复，但缺乏专业工具，那么加入我们的俱乐部吧。

sentence_translations.sentence: There's a range of reference manuals available and a mechanic to offer advice.
sentence_translations.translation: 这里有一系列参考手册可用，还有一位机械师提供建议。

sentence_translations.sentence: 25. Cycling Training
sentence_translations.translation: 骑行培训

sentence_translations.sentence: 26. Our qualified instructors can teach you how to ride your bike, whether you have had prior experience or not.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们合格的教练可以教你如何骑自行车，无论你是否具备相关经验。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're already riding and would like to build your confidence, we can teach you safe techniques to negotiate traffic.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你已经在骑行并希望增强自信，我们可以教你应对交通的安全技巧。

sentence_translations.sentence: 27. Booking Information
sentence_translations.translation: 预订信息

sentence_translations.sentence: 28. To book a place, email training@bikefoundry.org
sentence_translations.translation: 要预订名额，请发送电子邮件至 training@bikefoundry.org

sentence_translations.sentence: 29. We ask for a 50% deposit to confirm your place, refundable up to seven days before the course.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们要求支付50%的定金以确认你的名额，在开课前七天之内可退款。

sentence_translations.sentence: These are classes for those of you who can already make basic meals by keeping strictly to a simple recipe, but who would now like to use your imagination as well.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些课程适合那些已经能够严格按照简单食谱制作基本餐食，但现在还想运用自己的想象力的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: We'll learn how to make great family meals, discovering how to develop basic recipes into personal creations, with a few tricks and tips to help you become more confident.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将学习如何制作美味家庭餐，探索如何将基本食谱发展为个人创意，并利用一些小技巧和贴士帮助你变得更加自信。

sentence_translations.translation: B 轻松待客之道

sentence_translations.sentence: This course has plenty of ideas and tips for special occasions that you can enjoy preparing, love eating and be proud to provide.
sentence_translations.translation: 本课程提供大量针对特殊场合的创意与建议，这些场合中你能享受准备过程、喜爱品尝食物并自豪地呈现给他人。

sentence_translations.translation: 请穿着合适的工坊服装，并携带笔记本和笔。

sentence_translations.sentence: E Photography

sentence_translations.translation: 本课程将让你充分利用你的数码相机。

sentence_translations.sentence: To really benefit from the course, learners should have time to read ahead between sessions.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了真正从课程中受益，学习者应在课程间歇有时间预先阅读。

sentence_translations.sentence: F Creative writing
sentence_translations.translation: F 创意写作

sentence_translations.sentence: Come and learn how to have fun with stories and other kinds of creative writing.
sentence_translations.translation: 快来学习如何享受故事及其他创意写作的乐趣吧。

sentence_translations.translation: 我们将尝试一些新思路和技巧，以改进写作风格并激发想象力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Writers who have not taken the foundation class will also be able to join, provided they already have some experience of the subject.
sentence_translations.translation: 未参加过基础课程的作者也可以加入，前提是他们已经具备一些相关经验。

sentence_translations.translation: 自行车工坊

sentence_translations.translation: 自行车铸造厂旨在推广骑行，并尽可能让更多人享受到一种环保的交通和休闲方式。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Benefits for staff of Hamberton Hospital

paragraphs.text: Our attractive benefits package is one of the ways we acknowledge the contribution they all make in the provision of high quality patient care. Our package is extensive and varied.
paragraphs.translation:
我们具有吸引力的福利待遇方案，是我们认可所有员工在提供高质量患者护理方面所做贡献的方式之一。
我们的方案内容广泛且多样。

paragraphs.text: As a Hamberton employee you'll enjoy both National Health Service (NHS) and locally developed schemes, providing you with a range of benefits. These include:
paragraphs.translation:
作为Hamberton医院的员工，您将享有国家医疗服务体系（NHS）和本地制定的计划，为您提供一系列福利。
这些包括：
健康

paragraphs.text: Financial Benefits
paragraphs.translation: 财务福利

paragraphs.text: • opportunity to contribute to the NHS Pension Scheme - highly regarded by the independent pensions and insurance sector
paragraphs.translation: • 有机会加入NHS养老金计划——该计划备受独立养老金和保险行业的高度认可

paragraphs.text: • Injury Benefits Scheme
paragraphs.translation: • 工伤福利计划

paragraphs.text: • excellent occupational sick pay and maternity leave and pay entitlements
paragraphs.translation: • 优厚的职业病假工资以及产假和产假工资权益

paragraphs.text: • loans to assist with the purchase of housing for employees in the health service
paragraphs.translation:
• 为卫生服务部门的员工提供购房贷款
健康

paragraphs.text: Work-Life Balance
paragraphs.translation: 工作与生活的平衡

paragraphs.text: Here at Hamberton we are committed to helping all employees balance their work and home life commitments. We believe by helping people make this balance we are able to recruit, retain and motivate the most valuable asset of the NHS - our employees. We are committed to making this balance work for all employees equally, not just parents.
paragraphs.translation:
在汉伯顿，我们致力于帮助所有员工平衡工作与家庭生活的责任。
我们相信，通过帮助人们实现这种平衡，我们能够招聘、留住并激励NHS最宝贵的资产——我们的员工。
我们致力于让这种平衡对所有员工都同样有效，而不仅仅是针对为人父母者。

paragraphs.text: Over 50% of our staff work part-time in a range of flexible working options, which include:
paragraphs.translation: 我们超过50%的员工通过一系列灵活的工作选择从事兼职工作，这些选择包括：

paragraphs.text: • job sharing
paragraphs.translation: • 工作分摊制

paragraphs.text: • term-time-only working
paragraphs.translation: • 仅学期制工作

paragraphs.text: • part-time working
paragraphs.translation: • 兼职工作

paragraphs.text: • individually-tailored working patterns
paragraphs.translation: • 个性化定制的工作模式

paragraphs.text: We also support employees further through our caring and special leave arrangements.
paragraphs.translation: 我们还通过关怀和特殊休假安排进一步支持员工。

paragraphs.text: Health
paragraphs.translation: 健康

paragraphs.text: • our own occupational health department, providing a totally confidential service open to all staff during normal working hours
paragraphs.translation:
健康
• 我们自己的职业健康部门，在正常工作时间向所有员工提供完全保密的服务

paragraphs.text: • a round-the-clock free and confidential counselling service
paragraphs.translation: • 一项全天候免费且保密的咨询服务

paragraphs.text: • policies supporting phased returns to work after long illnesses or injuries
paragraphs.translation: • 支持员工在长期病患或受伤后逐步返岗的政策

paragraphs.text: Other Benefits
paragraphs.translation: 其他福利

paragraphs.text: On-site facilities include:
paragraphs.translation: 现场设施包括：

paragraphs.text: • excellent food provided in our restaurant
paragraphs.translation: • 在我们的餐厅提供的优质食物

paragraphs.text: • ample parking
paragraphs.translation: • 充足的停车位

paragraphs.text: • retail outlets
paragraphs.translation: • 零售门店

paragraphs.text: NHS Discounts
paragraphs.translation: NHS折扣

paragraphs.text: All NHS employees can access the NHS Discounts scheme. This allows members of staff free access to a number of discounted products and services. For example, discounts are available at many high street shops and elsewhere, including savings on toys, utility bills, days out, and much more.
paragraphs.translation:
NHS折扣
所有NHS员工都可以享受NHS折扣计划。
这使员工可以免费获得许多折扣产品和服务。
例如，许多高街商店及其他地方都提供折扣，包括在玩具、水电费、外出游玩等方面节省开支，以及更多其他优惠。

paragraphs.text: Red Guava
paragraphs.translation: 红番石榴

paragraphs.text: This is a further discount benefit, which is available to employees of Hamberton. Red Guava provides discounts on holidays, for example, and can save you money in many other ways too.
paragraphs.translation:
红番石榴
这是一项额外的折扣福利，适用于Hamberton医院的员工。
例如，Red Guava提供假期折扣，并且还能在许多其他方面为您节省开支。

paragraphs.text: Performance-related pay
paragraphs.translation: 绩效相关薪酬

paragraphs.text: There are a number of reasons why your employer might introduce this type of pay scheme. They may:
paragraphs.translation:
你的雇主可能出于多种原因引入这种薪酬方案。
他们可能：

paragraphs.text: • be keen to retain current staff
paragraphs.translation: • 渴望留住现有员工

paragraphs.text: • want to compete for new talent
paragraphs.translation: • 希望竞争新的人才

paragraphs.text: • be seeking a fairer way of distributing wages.
paragraphs.translation: • 寻求一种更公平的工资分配方式。

paragraphs.text: In order for performance-related schemes to work they should be based on clear, measurable targets agreed by both employer and employee. You will normally find out about these targets from your contract of employment and the performance appraisal meetings you have with your manager.
paragraphs.translation:
为了使绩效相关方案发挥作用，它们应基于雇主和雇员双方共同商定的明确、可衡量的目标。
你通常可以通过劳动合同以及与管理层进行的绩效评估会议来了解这些目标。

paragraphs.text: Short-term schemes
paragraphs.translation: 短期计划

paragraphs.text: Short-term schemes usually offer bonus payments, or, depending on the type of work, commission on sales achieved. Payments vary and these schemes are normally used just to encourage staff to improve their own performance.
paragraphs.translation:
短期计划
短期计划通常提供奖金，或根据工作类型，提供基于已实现销售额的佣金。
支付金额各不相同，这些计划通常仅用于鼓励员工提升自身绩效。

paragraphs.text: Long-term schemes
paragraphs.translation: 长期计划

paragraphs.text: Long-term schemes offer rewards like share options, and can help to encourage loyalty to the organisation and its aims. Such schemes tend to be used as a way of retaining senior staff.
paragraphs.translation:
长期计划
长期计划提供诸如股票期权之类的奖励，并有助于鼓励员工对组织及其目标的忠诚度。
此类计划通常被用作留住高级员工的一种方式。

paragraphs.text: What to do if you have problems
paragraphs.translation: 遇到问题时的应对措施

paragraphs.text: If you don't receive bonus or commission payments which you believe you are owed, check your contract of employment or staff handbook to see how your bonus is paid. Ask your employer if you need more information.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你没有得到你认为应得的奖金或佣金，请检查你的雇佣合同或员工手册，了解奖金的支付方式。
如需更多信息，请询问你的雇主。

paragraphs.text: If you think a mistake has been made, you should:
paragraphs.translation: 如果你认为出现了错误，你应该：

paragraphs.text: • speak to your employer to see if there has been a misunderstanding
paragraphs.translation: • 与你的雇主沟通，看是否存在误会。

paragraphs.text: • ask your employer to set out in writing how they have calculated your pay
paragraphs.translation: • 要求雇主以书面形式说明他们如何计算你的薪酬

paragraphs.text: • keep copies of any letters and notes of any meetings.
paragraphs.translation: • 保留所有信函和任何会议记录的副本。

paragraphs.text: There are three ways that the law might cover a case of unpaid bonuses:
paragraphs.translation: 法律可能涵盖未支付奖金案件的三种方式为：

paragraphs.text: • breach of contract
paragraphs.translation: • 违约

paragraphs.text: • unlawful deductions from wages
paragraphs.translation: • 非法从工资中扣款

paragraphs.text: • unlawful discrimination.
paragraphs.translation:
• 非法歧视。
歧视

paragraphs.text: Deductions from wages / breach of contract
paragraphs.translation:
• 违约
从工资中扣除款项 / 违约行为

paragraphs.text: Any right to a bonus will normally be included in your contract of employment. It may not always be written down. It can be verbally agreed or understood to be there due to normal practice in your particular area of business.
paragraphs.translation:
任何获得奖金的权利通常都会包含在你的雇佣合同中。
它可能并不总是白纸黑字地写下来。
它可能通过口头协议达成，或是由于你所在特定业务领域的惯例而被默认存在。

paragraphs.text: Failure to pay a bonus or commission that you are entitled to could amount to an unlawful deduction of wages.
paragraphs.translation: 未支付你应得的奖金或佣金可能构成非法克扣工资。

paragraphs.text: Discrimination
paragraphs.translation: 歧视

paragraphs.text: Your employer must not discriminate against particular groups of people - for example, by giving smaller bonuses to women. Ideally your employer should have some guidelines setting out the normal range of bonuses to give, and these must be followed without discriminating against any specific group.
paragraphs.translation:
你的雇主不得歧视特定人群——例如，给予女性较小的奖金。
理想情况下，你的雇主应制定一些指引，列明奖金的正常发放范围，并且必须遵循这些指引，不得歧视任何特定群体。

sentence_translations.sentence: Performance-related pay

sentence_translations.sentence: There are a number of reasons why your employer might introduce this type of pay scheme.

sentence_translations.sentence: They may:

sentence_translations.translation: • 渴望留住现有员工

sentence_translations.sentence: • want to compete for new talent
sentence_translations.translation: • 希望竞争新的人才

sentence_translations.sentence: • be seeking a fairer way of distributing wages.
sentence_translations.translation: • 寻求一种更公平的工资分配方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: In order for performance-related schemes to work they should be based on clear, measurable targets agreed by both employer and employee.

sentence_translations.sentence: You will normally find out about these targets from your contract of employment and the performance appraisal meetings you have with your manager.

sentence_translations.sentence: Short-term schemes

sentence_translations.sentence: Short-term schemes usually offer bonus payments, or, depending on the type of work, commission on sales achieved.

sentence_translations.sentence: If you don't receive bonus or commission payments which you believe you are owed, check your contract of employment or staff handbook to see how your bonus is paid.

sentence_translations.sentence: If you think a mistake has been made, you should:

sentence_translations.sentence: • unlawful deductions from wages

sentence_translations.sentence: • unlawful discrimination.

What's interesting is that overfishing isn't the main agent of the decline, as we might assume. It's due to an ongoing combination of exploitation, habitat destruction and pollution. Coastal development, for example, destroys large areas of wetlands that support a range of species. Pollution fuels a process known as eutrophication, which kills certain seagrasses. Nutrients such as nitrogen and phosphorus contained in human and industrial waste promote the growth of tiny phytoplankton. sentence_translations.sentence: For some time now, the world's oceans and the people who fish them have been a constant source of bad environmental news: cod is effectively an endangered species of fish in some places now; every year thousands of dolphins are injured by fishing vessels; huge tuna farms are ruining the Mediterranean Sea.

sentence_translations.sentence: What is more, marine biologists recently warned that our seafood is in terminal decline.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，海洋生物学家最近警告说，我们的海鲜资源正在急剧减少。

sentence_translations.sentence: According to research published in Science last November, stocks of all the fish and shellfish that we currently eat will collapse before 2050.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据去年十一月发表在《科学》杂志上的研究，我们目前食用的所有鱼类和贝类的种群将在2050年前崩溃。

sentence_translations.sentence: Or at least, that's how the media reported it.
sentence_translations.translation: 至少，媒体是这样报道的。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the scientist who led the study has said that the main conclusion of his research has been buried beneath the headlines.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，领导这项研究的科学家表示，他研究的主要结论已被头条新闻所掩盖。

sentence_translations.sentence: While the danger to our seafood supply is real enough, says Boris Worm, assistant professor of marine conservation biology at Dalhousie University, Canada, there is a more serious point: that the way in which we manage the oceans is not only threatening the survival of individual species, it's upsetting the delicate balance of marine communities and thus causing the collapse of entire ecosystems.
sentence_translations.translation: 加拿大达尔豪斯大学海洋保护生物学助理教授鲍里斯·沃姆表示，虽然对我们海鲜供应的威胁确实存在，但更严重的一点是：我们管理海洋的方式不仅威胁着单个物种的生存，还破坏了海洋群落的微妙平衡，从而导致整个生态系统的崩溃。

sentence_translations.sentence: Research has shown that the number of ecosystems where all higher forms of life are extinct, so-called dead zones, is increasing.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，所有高等生命形式都已灭绝的生态系统——即所谓的死亡区——数量正在增加。

sentence_translations.sentence: The point that many reports failed to highlight, says Worm, is that we have to revolutionise the way our marine resources are run, changing the focus from stocks and quotas to biodiversity and ecosystem protection.
sentence_translations.translation: 沃姆说，许多报道未能强调的一点是，我们必须彻底改革海洋资源的管理方式，将重点从种群和配额转向生物多样性和生态系统保护。

sentence_translations.sentence: And to do that, we must change the way the debate about our marine resources is conducted in the public domain.
sentence_translations.translation: 要做到这一点，我们必须改变公众领域内关于海洋资源讨论的方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Around 7,500 years ago, shrinking glaciers and the resulting higher water levels led to the development of what's called the Wadden Sea, a 13,500-square-kilometre area of the North Sea.
sentence_translations.translation: 大约7500年前，冰川消退导致海平面上升，形成了所谓的瓦登海，这是北海一片面积达13500平方公里的区域。

sentence_translations.sentence: During the first 5,000 years or so, the sea pulsated with life.
sentence_translations.translation: 在最初的5000年左右，这片海域充满了生机。

sentence_translations.sentence: There was a high level of biodiversity on the seabed too, and the salt marshes and mud flats on the coast supported millions of birds.
sentence_translations.translation: 海底的生物多样性也很高，海岸上的盐沼和泥滩供养了数百万只鸟类。

sentence_translations.sentence: This continued until around 2,000 years ago, when human pressure began to affect it.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种情况一直持续到大约2000年前，人类活动的影响开始显现。

sentence_translations.sentence: Research has shown that some of the larger creatures disappeared more than 500 years ago.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，一些较大的生物在500多年前就已消失。

sentence_translations.translation: 这是由于开发、栖息地破坏和污染持续结合造成的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Coastal development, for example, destroys large areas of wetlands that support a range of species.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，沿海开发破坏了支撑多种物种的大片湿地。

sentence_translations.sentence: Pollution fuels a process known as eutrophication, which kills certain seagrasses.
sentence_translations.translation: 污染加剧了称为富营养化的过程，这会杀死某些海草。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nutrients such as nitrogen and phosphorus contained in human and industrial waste promote the growth of tiny phytoplankton.

sentence_translations.sentence: This over-enrichment of the sea can ultimately lead to the collapse of the entire system through oxygen starvation.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种海洋的过度富营养化最终可能因缺氧导致整个系统崩溃。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most marine ecosystems have an in-built capacity to deal with a certain amount of pollution because shellfish can absorb phytoplankton.
sentence_translations.translation: 大多数海洋生态系统具有处理一定量污染的内在能力，因为贝类可以吸收浮游植物。

sentence_translations.sentence: But in many cases, these have been largely removed by fishing, so the effect of any nutrient-rich pollutants entering the system is increased.
sentence_translations.translation: 但在许多情况下，这些贝类已被捕捞大量移除，因此任何富含营养的污染物进入系统后的影响都被放大了。

sentence_translations.sentence: In a healthy system, coastal wetlands also act as filters, so their destruction causes even more pollution.
sentence_translations.translation: 在健康的系统中，沿海湿地也充当过滤器，因此它们的破坏会导致更严重的污染。

sentence_translations.sentence: These processes have been fairly well understood for a number of years.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些过程多年来已得到相当充分的理解。

sentence_translations.sentence: What the Science paper has demonstrated, however, is that the decline in the health of ecosystems is greater where the number of different species is low.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，《科学》杂志的论文表明，在物种数量较少的地方，生态系统健康状况的下降更为严重。

sentence_translations.sentence: The population of marbled rock cod around the South Atlantic island of South Georgia, for example, still hasn't recovered after the fishing industry caused its collapse during the 1970s.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，南大西洋南乔治亚岛附近的大理石岩鳕鱼种群在20世纪70年代因渔业导致崩溃后仍未恢复。

sentence_translations.sentence: By contrast, North Sea cod has withstood very heavy fishing for hundreds of years, says Worm, and although it has declined substantially, it hasn't yet collapsed completely.
sentence_translations.translation: 相比之下，沃姆说，北海鳕鱼已经承受了数百年的高强度捕捞，尽管其数量大幅下降，但尚未完全崩溃。

sentence_translations.sentence: Worm believes that, 'to have a greater number of species makes an ecosystem more robust'.
sentence_translations.translation: 沃姆认为，“拥有更多的物种使生态系统更加稳健”。

sentence_translations.sentence: His theory is backed up by evidence from experiments into how ecosystems react to change.
sentence_translations.translation: 他的理论得到了关于生态系统如何应对变化的实验证据的支持。

sentence_translations.sentence: And some positive news came from the study.
sentence_translations.translation: 这项研究也带来了一些积极的消息。

sentence_translations.sentence: Worm and his colleagues were able to show that it's possible to reverse such damage as long as there are enough species.
sentence_translations.translation: 沃姆和他的同事们能够证明，只要有足够的物种，就有可能逆转这种损害。

sentence_translations.sentence: A survey of 44 protected areas revealed increases in biodiversity and fish catches close to the reserves.
sentence_translations.translation: 一项对44个保护区的调查显示，保护区附近的生物多样性和渔获量有所增加。

sentence_translations.sentence: Worm says, 'We should be focusing our attention on protecting all of our marine resources at the ecosystem level, and managing levels of fishing, pollution and habitat disturbance to ensure that crucial services that maintain the health of the ecosystem continue to function.'
sentence_translations.translation: 沃姆说：“我们应该将注意力集中在生态系统层面保护所有海洋资源，并管理捕捞、污染和栖息地干扰的程度，以确保维持生态系统健康的关键服务持续运作。”

sentence_translations.sentence: To anyone who knows anything about ecology, it would appear that Worm is just stating the obvious.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于任何了解生态学的人来说，沃姆似乎只是在陈述显而易见的事实。

sentence_translations.sentence: And many protected areas on land are now managed in this way.
sentence_translations.translation: 而且，陆地上的许多保护区现在正是以这种方式管理的。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, there has long been a tendency to view our oceans as a limitless resource, combined with a widespread failure to make an emotional connection with most marine wildlife.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，人们长期倾向于将海洋视为无限的资源，同时普遍未能与大多数海洋野生动物建立情感联系。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'We seem to have understood the value of protecting ecosystems in areas such as the Australian Great Barrier Reef that we consider to be particularly beautiful; says John Shepherd, Professor of Marine Sciences at Southampton University in the UK.'

sentence_translations.sentence: For some time now, the world's oceans and the people who fish them have been a constant source of bad environmental news: cod is effectively an endangered species of fish in some places now; every year thousands of dolphins are injured by fishing vessels; huge tuna farms are ruining the Mediterranean Sea.

sentence_translations.sentence: What is more, marine biologists recently warned that our seafood is in terminal decline.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，海洋生物学家最近警告称，我们的海产品正面临最终枯竭。
